description: This file provides functions for live retrieval of Feishu directory peers and groups, including fallback to static data, using Feishu API clients.

methods.name: listFeishuDirectoryPeersLive
methods.description: Fetches live list of Feishu directory peers with optional query filtering and fallback to static data.

methods.name: listFeishuDirectoryGroupsLive
methods.description: Fetches live list of Feishu directory groups with optional query filtering and fallback to static data.
